name: B-Spline Camera Path Interpolation
aliases: Multidimensional B-Spline Interpolation for Camera Poses
definition: Creates a smooth spline path between input keyframe camera poses using multidimensional B-spline interpolation.
summary: B-Spline Camera Path Interpolation generates smooth, continuous camera trajectories for volume rendering by fitting multidimensional B-splines to keyframe poses, ensuring higher-order continuity than linear methods.
